headline: Record year with strong margin gains; steady outlook ahead
summary_short: Net sales of $1,160M rose 17% y/y and adjusted EPS of $2.83 rose 35%; full-year sales reached $4,357M, up 22%, with free cash flow of $131M falling 28% on higher capex.
summary_long: Aerospace sales grew 18% to $781M and Industrial grew 14% to $380M. Industrial margin widened about 610bp to 20.7% while Aerospace margin was little changed at 24.3%. Capex rose to $163M from $52M. Share repurchases were $154M in the quarter. Fiscal 2027 guidance calls for sales growth of 6% to 10%, adjusted EPS of $10.20 to $10.70 and free cash flow of $400M to $450M. Total debt was $1,422M.
confidence_notes: The shard labels this event FY2026 Q3, but the release covers the fourth quarter and full fiscal year ended September 30, 2026 (fiscal-offset labelling issue). Figures shown are the three months ended September 30, 2026 versus the prior-year quarter. Adjusted EPS is non-GAAP.

drivers.explanation: Higher aircraft production rates and strong repair-center inputs drove double-digit growth in Commercial OEM and Services; Industrial benefited from strong demand across end markets.
Earnings rose on higher sales volumes and price realization, partially offset by inflation.
Price realization and volume lifted earnings, offset by inflation and strategic investments in manufacturing capabilities, leaving margin roughly flat.
Operating cash flow rose to $294M but capital expenditures climbed to $163M from $52M.
Management cites strong demand, disciplined execution and expanded capacity as the base for solid growth in 2027.
